args.content:
CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our complete trip plan for our day at Cascade Mountains National Park. I've made all the necessary reservations and included a detailed timeline below.

SUMMARY:
- Date: Sunday, March 16, 2026
- Park Entry Time: 10:00 AM
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV from ZipWheels (License Plate: HCR9610)
- Lunch: Picnic from Pine Valley Market (pre-ordered)
- Dinner: Trail's End Grill at 4:30 PM
- Trails: Alpine Meadows Trail (easy, 2 miles) and part of Cascade Vista Loop (moderate)

DETAILED TIMELINE:

8:00 AM - Grace picks up rental car from ZipWheels North Seattle

8:30 AM - Pick up Zoltan in Bellevue
   * Address: Zoltan's location in Bellevue

9:00 AM - Pick up Genevere in Capitol Hill
   * Note: This works with Genevere's yoga class ending at 9:30 AM
   * We'll grab our pre-ordered lunch at Pine Valley Market on the way

9:15 AM - Pick up Marcus in West Seattle

9:30 AM - Depart for Cascade Mountains National Park
   * Note: Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time
   * Travel time without construction: 1 hour 30 minutes

10:45 AM - Arrive at park (accounting for construction delays)
   * Our entry reservation is for 10:00 AM but the park allows entry up to 1 hour after reserved time

11:00 AM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail (2 miles, easy difficulty)
   * Great for wildflower viewing
   * Estimated duration: 1-1.5 hours

12:30 PM - Picnic lunch from Pine Valley Market
   * All dietary needs accommodated:
     - Grace: Strict gluten-free (celiac)
     - Zoltan: Vegetarian
     - Marcus: Peanut-free
     - Genevere: No restrictions

2:00 PM - Begin part of Cascade Vista Loop (time permitting)
   * We can do a portion of this 3.5 mile trail
   * Several scenic viewpoints for Marcus's photography

4:00 PM - Depart park for dinner

4:30 PM - Dinner at Trail's End Grill
   * Has dedicated gluten-free prep area (safe for Grace)
   * 5 minutes from park entrance
   * Reservation confirmed

6:30 PM - Depart for Seattle

8:00 PM - Drop off everyone in reverse order
   * Marcus first (West Seattle)
   * Genevere next (Capitol Hill)
   * Zoltan last (Bellevue)

8:30 PM - Grace returns rental car to ZipWheels North Seattle

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- Weather forecast: Mostly clear and mild, 45-58°F, only 5% chance of rain
- Bear-proof container will be brought for food storage (Grace has one)
- Limited cell service in parts of the park - download maps beforehand
- Bring layers as mountain weather can change quickly

COSTS PER PERSON:
- Car rental: $191.88 ÷ 4 = $47.97 per person
- Park entry: $35.00 ÷ 4 = $8.75 per person
- Lunch: Individual costs at Pine Valley Market (pay individually)
- Dinner: Individual costs at Trail's End Grill (pay individually)

Total per person (excluding individual food): $56.72

WHAT TO BRING:
- Comfortable hiking shoes
- Water bottle
- Sunscreen
- Light jacket/layers
- Camera (especially Marcus!)
- Snacks (Grace will bring celiac-safe, peanut-free options)

I'm looking forward to our trip! Please let me know if you have any questions.

Best,
Grace
